same_gaia_astrometric_reference.interpretation: If DIFFERENT_GAIA <=5 displacement vectors collapse toward zero after subtracting the same-Gaia median plate-pair offset, this supports an astrometric/crossmatch systematic rather than physical parallax.
same_gaia_astrometric_reference.offset_model: diagnostic rigid tangent-plane translation only: median dRA*cos(dec), dDec in arcsec; this does not alter source coordinates or population membership
same_gaia_astrometric_reference.reference_pairs: mutual-nearest SAME_GAIA pairs with observed separation <=60 arcsec within each opportunity
same_gaia_astrometric_reference.robust_scatter: median radial deviation from the median same-Gaia offset vector

fixed_diagnostics.source_reuse: Machine-only source IDs may be used to count repeated DIFFERENT_GAIA <=5 incidences and repeated source-pair incidences. Only aggregate counts/fractions/maxima may be emitted.

input_population.geometry: exact selected v094h/v094i solution polygons and common-footprint rule
input_population.primary_residual_population: mutual nearest-neighbour DIFFERENT_GAIA pairs with cross-site separation <=5 arcsec
input_population.secondary_residual_population: mutual nearest-neighbour DIFFERENT_GAIA pairs with separation <=60 arcsec
input_population.source_cache: exact 1,386 strict-HQ (scan_id, solution_num) caches frozen/inventoried by v094j

known_at_freeze.interpretation_boundary: The residual is strongly concentrated by site pair and epoch. This is mechanism evidence only; it is not yet evidence for parallax or transience.

purpose: Diagnose the highly concentrated residual DIFFERENT_GAIA mutual-nearest-neighbour population in the corrected <=5 minute strict-HQ branch before any physical-parallax interpretation, source-quality threshold relaxation, candidate inspection, controls, pixels, or registration.
stop_rule: Stop after aggregate concentration/crowding/Gaia-association/astrometric-residual mechanism results. Interpret before any physical parallax stage, lower-quality sensitivity branch, or individual inspection.
